about_the_game:
You finally checked into the legendary Hardcastle… and someone pulled a dirty trick on you! Your precious Bara card collection has been scattered all over the place — hidden by a mystery man with a very playful sense of humor.

Now it’s up to you to explore the castle hotel room by room and sniff out your missing cards.

Search behind tapestries, inside treasure chests, under silky bedsheets, and in all the suspicious places a naughty knight might stash something.

Unlock steamy illustrations and slowly rebuild your hard-earned collection, one musclebound card at a time.

Ready for a cheeky, ripped, and ridiculously fun scavenger hunt? Only true Bara lovers can recover every last card!

  •  100 Sensual Cards

  • 7 Interactive Medieval Rooms

  • Play with One Hand

  • Controller Support

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains explicit nudity, consensual sexual content, and mature themes. It focuses on Bara characters presented in many forms, such as monsters, angels, demons, cyborgs, and others. 

Sexual interactions occur between humans and non-human creatures, including monsters. Some characters appear in BDSM outfits and fetish gear. For mature audiences only.
